content_html:
There are three things that define human interactions with its own world.

1. Energy

2. Attention

3. Courage

I have energy. Maybe God’s blessing, maybe genetics, maybe luck. Since I was a child, this was the thing I had. Energy. Don’t know how to control it, how I can affect it. But I have this shit.

My attention is misplaced -> and I know this for a while. Girard debates x curiosity. Living for the prestige x being a good human being. I already have explored a lot about this.

However, there was one thing I always undermined. One thing I always ignored. Courage. And guess what, I am a fucking coward. In every aspect of my life. And this “every aspect” is important.

There is no work. Or gym. Or friends. Or relationship. It is all life. It is all part of the same fucking mindset. In my dream life I don’t divide between them. I don’t have a “friend mindset” or a “work mindset”. I wanna be good and be complete in every fucking aspect of it (this is energy speaking).

My attention is not the best. But still moves me towards good directions.

My aim problem was never that. It was and it is courage.

If wasn’t by a forth factor, called mother, this fucking cowardice would make me be in fucking FEA working at some random job to support myself. I would never have kissed a girl. Or go to Mykonos. Or be at a Duke.

The duality I’ve always felt between knowing I was better than almost everybody else and at the same time do not wanting to go abroad because I though ir wasn’t for me was not impostor syndrome. It was being a little bitch. A coward piece of shit.

“But oh, I don’t know if it is rational to approach this girl because of xxx xxx” -> shut up your fucking piece of shit.

“But oh, how can I have a view in the stock? I don’t know nothing about it, and there are so many people better than me at this. Oh” -> go fuck yourself your coward. Coward. Coward.

Energy is how fast you expand. Attention is where you want to expand. Courage is the fucking barrier that makes you have to work way more to get to the other side.
